title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Annulment of marriage 7606 views Q. I am an Indian Muslim residing in Kerala State now working in saudi Arabia. I am writing this letter for my younger sister who married on April 15 2007 in Masjid as per Hanafee school of thought. He is working in Dubai and was on vacation during the time of marriage. Now her life is fully in trouble. Actually that marriage itself was a great mistake. She didn?t live with her husband and family even for two months. That man is a saddist ,he and his parents tortured my sister and finally on June 2nd week they beated her like anything, and she told us everything and we took her to our house. Then some discussions in family level has been done and my sister categorically told us that she can?t live anymore with her husband. Then I contacted her hus. And he agreed for a mutual divorce through mahallu committee. But the next day without informing any of us he left to Dubai (Now he is in Dubai) After that he never called my sister or he even not send any money to her. My sister informed that she never wants to continue a life with that man. Her all ornaments and money are in the custody of her in laws. There is only my mother and herself only in my home at Kerala. In August 3rd we submitted an application to our Mahallu committee for a divorce. They send our application to her husband?s Mahallu committee and there is no response so far. Also then her husband phoned her and threatened that he will never divorce her and also he will do another marriage and will hurt my sister like anything. Then in consultation with our Mahallu committee my sister filed a case before the family court on 22nd August 2007, for getting back her ornaments and money from her husband?s in laws custody.(She has not filed any case for divorce before the court). Now the Mahallu committee informed us that, she can do Fasah, the procedure is she has to give an advertisement in the local news paper saying that her husband is not looking after her, and if he is not contacting her in another 20 days, she don?t want to have a relationship. Then this advertisement and another letter will be send to her husband?s mahallu committee and then the marriage will be divorced. Would you please advice me about the legal validity of this procedure as per Sahria and laws in India. After doing this can she re marry? Or if she wants to do Khula what is the procedure in India. I think its very difficult to get a divorce through court since her husband is not in India and it seems he is Absconding and living in Dubai, Insha Allah I hope you will answer to all my queries and help me to overcome the present dilemma and to get a good future for my sister 4901 views Q. I have been seperated from my partner/ex since 2004 now. She walked out with son and made a court case alleging domestic violence etc. After 3 years, Halhamdulillah, the son lives me. She lost her as court decided that she has mental illness. Is Talaq automatic in this case? I have tried to patch up with her but she swore at the case workers.I have also given her talaq over the phone 2 years ago and also some other time, without witnesses but she says do whatever. She also said that my mother will goto hell when she passed away.I need to move on as I am ill and has a son to look after. Please give some advice. Jazakamuullah Khairun. Wa Sallam. 1570 views Q. 3 talaq in one time by telephone 5123 views Q. I need your suggestion and guidance over issue of talaq between my elder sister and her husband, to put the whole incidence in short 2024 views Q. My brother is going through bad marriage since last 16 years and he wants to divorce his wife they don't have any relationship and don't even live in the same bedroom my brother sleeps in hall and bhabhi in bedroom with children 2282 views Q. Due to bad behavior with me and my 2 sons I verbally pronounced Talak thrice to my wife. She refused to acknowledge the Talak saying that there was no witness to the Talak. Thereafter I pronounced Talak in the presence of a Mufti and 2 adult muslim witnesses. The written talaknama was sent to my wife by speed post which she has refused to accept. Technically she claims to have not been divorced and her family members support her. I left my house immediately after this incident and have been living in a separate house with my 2 sons for the last 2 and half years. As per the Muslim law and the Sharia, is my Talak valid. If it is please issue me Fatwa which I can produce in court so that my Talak can be recognized. 2270 views Q. asalualikum,respected mufti sahib,my sister got married 2 years back,her husband always force her to get money from us for his personal habits(consuming alchol),due to this he has sold some of her jewels . we talked to his parents they say its an emotional out burst & SOCIAL HABIT,and asked us to ignore it,now my sister feels that she cant live with him so we approched quazi shaib in our town,for a khula,but her husband say he still wants to live with her in front of the qazi,sir, can you please help us to get a khula with out his signature since the qazi refuse to end the marriage with out his signature , we have already retured his MAHAR. 2230 views Q. if muslim sunni person is married to muslim sunni girl and she forces him to divorce her in english court. he is forced into this matter and made by court to sign divorce documents. The judge grants divorce degree. But he has never given islamic divorce (talak). He still wants his wife . what is the islam says. Are they divorced islamicall or not. If the want to compromise and want to live together (which they both wanted) can they do it what the sharia says. 1828 views Q. One of my colleagues was divorced by her husband on paper. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 30440 Country: United Kingdom Title: Their is Sharee-Counsil in london can they do FASAAQH of my NIKAAH in london as this country is not a muslim country if they can then please answer my question with evidence from Quraan and Sunaah if not then also give me the evidence from Quraan and Sunaah. Question: Dear Mufti Sabaab A.salam-o-Alikum Their is Sharee-Counsil in london can they do FASAAQH of my NIKAAH in london as this country is not a muslim country if they can then please answer my question with evidence from Quraan and Sunaah if not then also give me the evidence from Quraan and Sunaah kind regards w.salam Answer ID: 30440 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 353/248/L=1432) If, in a non-Islamic country, any Shariah committee exists which consists at least one or two Alim and they revoke the nikah in the light of Shariah as per the guidelines mentioned in "Al-Heelah al-Najizah", then the nikah revoked by them shall be considered applicable as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
